seo.title: Sea freight France–Angola – FCL & LCL containers | MB Fret Services
seo.description: French freight forwarder based between Paris and Normandy, specialised in the France–Angola corridor. Sea freight in 20' and 40' containers (FCL/LCL) between France (Paris / Normandy via Le Havre) and Luanda, for international moves, vehicles and B2B cargo, with customs clearance and cargo insurance for a clear view of total delivered cost.

valueProps.title: Why choose MB Fret Services?
valueProps.subtitle: France‑based freight forwarder specialised in the France–Angola corridor. We help families, the diaspora and small businesses ship international moves, personal effects, vehicles and cargo between Paris / Normandy and Luanda, combining sea freight, customs clearance and cargo insurance from quote to delivery.

items.title: Sea Freight
items.description: Sea freight from France (Paris / Normandy via Le Havre) to Angola (Luanda) with FCL containers and LCL groupage for international moves, vehicles and B2B cargo, with real‑time tracking.

items.title: Customs clearance
items.description: Import/export customs clearance between France and Angola for your FCL/LCL containers, with document control, duties & taxes calculation and Incoterms guidance.

items.title: Cargo insurance
items.description: Ad valorem insurance for your containers (international moves, B2B cargo, vehicles, motorbikes) to Angola, integrated into your quotes for a clear view of total delivered cost.

destinations_subtitle: We focus our resources on the France–Angola (Luanda) corridor from France (Paris / Normandy via Le Havre), with solutions tailored to international moves, vehicles and B2B cargo.
destinations_need_specific: A specific project to Angola? We assess every request in detail.
